en: Hello! Welcome!
Peace be upon you. — And peace be upon you.
Good morning. — Good morning.
Good evening. — Good evening.
How are you? — Fine, praise be to God. And you? (to a man)
ar: كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ — بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. وَأَنْتَ؟

en: How is it going? — Not bad.
Nice to meet you. — Nice to meet you too. (to a man)
Welcome! Pleased to meet you. (to a woman)
Hello! I haven’t seen you in a while. How have you been? (to a man)
ar: مَرْحَبًا! لَمْ أَرَكَ مُنْذُ مُدَّةٍ. كَيْفَ كَانَتْ أَحْوَالُكَ؟

en: I missed you! How is your family? (to a woman)
It was nice talking with you. See you tomorrow! (to a man)
Goodbye! Take care of yourself. (to a woman)
Thank you. — You’re welcome.
Excuse me, please. (to a woman)
Congratulations! — Thank you; may God bless you. (to a man)
Wishing you well each year! — And you too. (to a woman)
ar: كُلُّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْرٍ! — وَأَنْتِ بِخَيْرٍ.

en: Don’t you speak Arabic?
I am learning formal Arabic.
I do not know a colloquial dialect.
My pronunciation is bad.
I do not pronounce some letters well.
I cannot have a conversation.
I want to speak the language fluently.
I wish to learn more about the culture.
ar: أَرْغَبُ فِي أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ المَزِيدَ عَنِ الثَّقَافَةِ.

en: Can you write in Arabic?
I know around 2,000 words.
I can spell about half of them.
I remember most words, but I forget sometimes.
ar: أَتَذَكَّرُ مُعْظَمَ الكَلِمَاتِ، لَكِنْ أَنْسَى أَحْيَانًا.

en: I am able to write short sentences.
I hope to improve my writing.
How do you practice?
I memorize vocabulary words every day.
Sometimes, I read Arabic literature.
I also read magazines and articles.
I listen to the news and podcasts.
I practice with a teacher.
He teaches me grammar.
He is a translator.
He works with the United Nations.
I am not the best pupil.
However, I review lessons often.
What is your first name?
My name is James.
What is your last name?
My last name is Smith.
What languages do you speak?
I speak English.
I also speak a little Spanish and Arabic.
ar: أَتَكَلَّمُ أَيْضًا قَلِيلًا مِنَ الإِسْبَانِيَّةِ وَالعَرَبِيَّةِ.

en: I do not speak French.
What is your birthday?
My birthday is June 16, 1998.
ar: تَارِيخُ مِيلَادِي هُوَ السَّادِسَ عَشَرَ مِنْ حَزِيرَانَ عَامَ ١٩٩٨.

en: How old are you?
I am 28 years old.
What is your nationality?
I am American.
What is your ethnicity?
I am white.
What is your family’s origin?
I am of Palestinian descent.
Where were you born?
I was born in the state of Hawaii.
Where do you live?
I live in the city of Miami.
What was your hometown?
My hometown is Kansas City, Missouri.
ar: المَدِينَةُ الَّتِي نَشَأْتُ فِيهَا هِيَ كَانْسَاس سِيتِي فِي وِلَايَةِ مِيزُورِي.

en: Do you live alone?
I live with my fiancée.
What is your phone number?
My phone number is (123) 456-7890.
What is your email address?
My email address is name@email.com.
What is your address?
My address is 123 Main Street, Miami, FL 33333.
ar: عُنْوَانِي هُوَ ١٢٣ شَارِع مَيْن، مِيَامِي، فُلُورِيدَا، ٣٣٣٣٣.

en: What is your zip code?
What is your passport number?
I don’t know.
Who are the members of your immediate family?
In my family, I have a dad, a mom, and a brother.
ar: فِي أُسْرَتِي، لِي أَبٌ وَأُمٌّ وَأَخٌ.

en: My dad’s name is Paul.
My mom’s name is Karen.
My brother’s name is Andrew.
My father and mother live together.
Our dog’s name is Banana.
Who are the members of your extended family?
I have many relatives in my extended family.
ar: لِي أَقَارِبُ كَثِيرُونَ فِي عَائِلَتِي الْكَبِيرَةِ.

en: I have aunts and uncles on both sides.
My grandmothers are alive.
My grandfathers are dead.
My grandmothers are lucky to have big families.
ar: جَدَّتَايَ مَحْظُوظَتَانِ لِأَنَّ لِكُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا عَائِلَةً كَبِيرَةً.

en: They have many grandsons and granddaughters.
I have two paternal uncles and a paternal aunt.
I have two paternal aunts and one maternal uncle.
I have male paternal cousins and female paternal cousins.
I have male maternal cousins and female paternal cousins.
My aunts and uncles have lots of children.
ar: لِعَمَّاتِي وَأَعْمَامِي وَخَالَاتِي وَأَخْوَالِي أَوْلَادٌ كَثِيرُونَ.

en: For example, I have a paternal uncle named Joe.
Joe’s wife is Colleen.
Joe’s son is Sam.
Joe’s daughters are Kate and Caroline.
I have a maternal aunt named Kelly.
Her daughter is Erica.
Are you married?
I am not married, but I am engaged.
ar: أَنَا لَسْتُ مُتَزَوِّجًا، لَكِنْ أَنَا مَخْطُوبٌ.

en: My fiancée’s name is Melanie.
Her last name is Cabrera.
I proposed last March.
I will get married to her in November.
We have a long engagement.
Our wedding will be close.
I do not think we will get divorced.
ar: لَا أَظُنُّ أَنَّ زَوَاجَنَا سَيَنْتَهِي بِالطَّلَاقِ.

en: Tell me about your future in-laws.
Melanie has a sister named Stephanie.
She is married to her husband, Noah.
I have a nephew, Ethan.
ar: لِي اِبْنُ أُخْتِ زَوْجَتِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلِيَّةِ، وَاسْمُهُ إِيثَان.

en: Ethan is the son of my sister-in-law and brother-in-law.
ar: إِيثَان هُوَ اِبْنُ أُخْتِ خَطِيبَتِي وَزَوْجِهَا.

en: My father-in-law was a mailman.
My mother-in-law was a teacher.
Melanie’s family lives in Miami.
Can you introduce me to your friends?
We should have a party sometime.
ar: يَنْبَغِي أَنْ نُقِيمَ حَفْلَةً فِي وَقْتٍ مَا.

en: Sure, but I don’t like socializing.
ar: بِالتَّأْكِيدِ، لَكِنْ لَا أُحِبُّ مُجَالَسَةَ النَّاسِ.

en: Who is that?
I will introduce you to him.
This is my friend Shawn.
This is his wife.
They are acquaintances with Ali.
Do you know Vijay?
No, but he is not a stranger.
He is an acquaintance.
Maybe I will meet him in the future.
I would like to get to know him.
What a nice picture!
That is my best friend Eric.
We have a long friendship.
I trust him a lot.
We were classmates in high school.
We do not spend time together often anymore.
ar: لَمْ نَعُدْ نَقْضِي الْوَقْتَ مَعًا كَثِيرًا.

en: But we are good with communication.
I have fun when we get together.
He had a fun personality.
I miss him.
Who has visited you recently?
Mohammed has visited me before.
I hosted him.
He was a good guest.
I will invite him again in the future.
He will probably accept the invitation.
Who is that?
That is our friend Ana.
Ana was our neighbor.
We are still in contact with her.
I graduated from the University of Michigan six years ago.
ar: تَخَرَّجْتُ مِنْ جَامِعَةِ مِيشِيغَانَ مُنْذُ سِتِّ سَنَوَاتٍ.

en: I received a bachelor’s degree in business administration after four years.
ar: حَصَلْتُ عَلَى شَهَادَةِ الْبَكَالُورِيُوسِ فِي إِدَارَةِ الْأَعْمَالِ بَعْدَ أَرْبَعِ سَنَوَاتٍ.

en: In America, four years is eight semesters.
ar: فِي أَمْرِيكَا، أَرْبَعُ سَنَوَاتٍ تُعَادِلُ ثَمَانِيَةَ فُصُولٍ دِرَاسِيَّةٍ.

en: Business was my major.
I did not study a minor.
Now, I am a specialist in finance.
My brother, Andrew, was a student there, also.
ar: كَانَ أَخِي أَنْدْرُو طَالِبًا هُنَاكَ أَيْضًا.

en: He studied physics and economics.
He is good at mathematics.
After receiving his bachelor’s degree, he studied law in California.
ar: بَعْدَ حُصُولِهِ عَلَى شَهَادَةِ الْبَكَالُورِيُوسِ، دَرَسَ الْحُقُوقَ فِي كَالِيفُورْنِيَا.

en: Now, he is a lawyer.
My roommate, Eytan, studied engineering at the same college.
ar: دَرَسَ رَفِيقِي فِي السَّكَنِ، إِيتَان، الْهَنْدَسَةَ فِي نَفْسِ الْكُلِّيَّةِ.

en: One time, we listened to the dean speak together.
ar: ذَاتَ مَرَّةٍ، اِسْتَمَعْنَا مَعًا إِلَى الْعَمِيدِ وَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ.

en: The dean spoke in a lecture about the office of admissions.
ar: تَكَلَّمَ الْعَمِيدُ فِي مُحَاضَرَةٍ عَنْ مَكْتَبِ الْقُبُولِ.

en: Later, my roommate obtained a doctorate.
ar: بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، حَصَلَ رَفِيقِي فِي السَّكَنِ عَلَى شَهَادَةِ الدُّكْتُورَاهِ.

en: His professor taught at the University of Michigan also.
ar: دَرَّسَ أُسْتَاذُهُ فِي جَامِعَةِ مِيشِيغَانَ أَيْضًا.

en: My fiancée, Melanie, studied medicine.
She is good at science.
She obtained a master’s degree.
Melanie received a scholarship from the hospital.
ar: حَصَلَتْ مِيلَانِي عَلَى مِنْحَةٍ مِنَ الْمُسْتَشْفَى.

en: After that, she obtained a doctorate.
ar: بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، حَصَلَتْ عَلَى شَهَادَةِ الدُّكْتُورَاهِ.

en: She wants to teach in the future.
She will be a great professor.
The subject of her research is excellent.
My friend, Nicole, studied psychology.
My friend’s wife studied political science and history.
ar: دَرَسَتْ زَوْجَةُ صَدِيقِي الْعُلُومَ السِّيَاسِيَّةَ وَالتَّارِيخَ.

en: I do not know anyone who studied anthropology.
ar: لَا أَعْرِفُ أَحَدًا دَرَسَ عِلْمَ الْإِنْسَانِ.

en: I am hungry and thirsty.
I would like some food and a drink.
Do you want to go to a café for breakfast?
ar: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ إِلَى مَقْهَى لِتَنَاوُلِ الْفُطُور؟

en: Sure, I will eat breakfast with you.
Let's go to the closest place.
Hello and welcome. Come in.
May I help you?
A table for two, please.
Right this way. Here is a menu.
ar: تَفَضَّلْ مِنْ هُنَا. هَذِهِ قَائِمَة الطَّعَام.

en: Can I bring you some bread and butter?
ar: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أُحْضِرَ لَكَ بَعْضَ الْخُبْز وَالزُّبْدَة؟

en: Yes, do you have jam also?
Of course.
What would you like to drink?
I would like a small cup of coffee with milk and sugar.
ar: أَرْغَبُ فِي فِنْجَانِ قَهْوَة صَغِير مَعَ الْحَلِيب وَالسُّكَّر.

en: And for you?
May I have a cold glass of mineral water without ice and a cup of hot tea?
ar: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَحْصُلَ عَلَى كُوبِ مَاء مَعْدِنِيّ بَارِد بِدُونِ ثَلْج، وَفِنْجَانِ شَاي سَاخِن؟

en: Here is a pitcher of water.
May I take your order?
I will have some eggs and fried potatoes.
I would like to order some fruit.
The dish looks tasty and smells good.
Can you please give me the salt and pepper? It is not salty enough.
ar: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي الْمِلْح وَالْفُلْفُل، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟ لَيْسَ فِيهِ مِلْح كَافٍ.

en: I need some silverware.
May I please have a fork and a knife?
ar: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَحْصُلَ عَلَى شَوْكَة وَسِكِّين، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟

en: Yes, here is a spoon and napkin, as well.
How was your meal?
Delicious! I am full.
Can I please have another cup of tea?
ar: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَحْصُلَ عَلَى فِنْجَانِ شَاي آخَر، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟

en: Would you like more coffee?
No thanks, just the bill.
Do you want to eat lunch or dinner later?
ar: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَتَنَاوَلَ الْغَدَاء أَوِ الْعَشَاء لَاحِقًا؟

en: Yes, let's go to a restaurant with our friends for dinner.
ar: نَعَم، دَعْنَا نَذْهَبْ إِلَى مَطْعَم مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِنَا لِتَنَاوُلِ الْعَشَاء.

en: The chef at Amal is excellent.
Their food is spicy.
They have soy options for vegetarians and vegans.
ar: عِنْدَهُمْ خِيَارَات مِنَ الصُّويَا لِلنَّبَاتِيِّين وَالنَّبَاتِيِّين الصِّرْف.

en: They have a menu for individuals with gluten, wheat, and other intolerances.
ar: عِنْدَهُمْ قَائِمَة طَعَام لِلْأَشْخَاص الَّذِينَ يُعَانُونَ مِنْ عَدَمِ تَحَمُّلِ الْغُلُوتِين أَوِ الْقَمْح أَوْ مَوَادّ أُخْرَى.

en: My friend is allergic to peanuts and tree nuts.
ar: صَدِيقِي عِنْدَهُ حَسَاسِيَّة مِنَ الْفُول السُّودَانِيّ وَالْمُكَسَّرَات الشَّجَرِيَّة.

en: Their menu will say if the dish contains nuts, dairy products, or shellfish.
ar: سَتُوَضِّحُ قَائِمَة الطَّعَام عِنْدَهُمْ مَا إِذَا كَانَ الطَّبَق يَحْتَوِي عَلَى مُكَسَّرَات أَوْ أَلْبَان أَوْ مَحَار.

en: I am happy I do not have an allergy!
ar: أَنَا سَعِيد لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَتْ عِنْدِي حَسَاسِيَّة!

en: I work in a small company.
Our company has 9 employees.
We invest in other businesses.
In the past, we invested in regional banks.
ar: فِي المَاضِي، اِسْتَثْمَرْنَا فِي بُنُوك إِقْلِيمِيَّة.

en: We invest in stocks and bonds.
I work in finance because I want to make money.
ar: أَعْمَلُ فِي التَّمْوِيل لِأَنَّنِي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَكْسِبَ المَال.

en: If I succeed, then I will become a millionaire.
My profession is hard.
The directors I work for are difficult.
ar: المُدِيرُونَ الَّذِينَ أَعْمَلُ تَحْتَ إِدَارَتِهِمْ صَعْبُو المِرَاس.

en: I have one colleague in the same position.
ar: لَدَيَّ زَمِيل وَاحِد فِي نَفْس المَنْصِب.

en: We earn the same salary.
When I interviewed, it was clear there was no formal training.
ar: عِنْدَمَا خَضَعْتُ لِمُقَابَلَة العَمَل، كَانَ مِنَ الوَاضِح أَنَّهُ لَا يُوجَدُ تَدْرِيب رَسْمِيّ.

en: Fortunately, I do not have much responsibility.
ar: لِحُسْنِ الحَظّ، لَيْسَتْ لَدَيَّ مَسْؤُولِيَّات كَثِيرَة.

en: The owners are in charge.
However, we share the same goal.
We want success for our investors.
If I fail, I will be fired.
I hope to retire soon.
I want to submit my resignation.
If I leave my job, I will look for another job outside finance.
ar: إِذَا تَرَكْتُ وَظِيفَتِي، فَسَأَبْحَثُ عَنْ وَظِيفَة أُخْرَى خَارِجَ التَّمْوِيل.

en: If I decide to leave, I will train someone before leaving.
ar: إِذَا قَرَّرْتُ أَنْ أُغَادِرَ، فَسَأُدَرِّبُ شَخْصًا قَبْلَ أَنْ أُغَادِرَ.

en: If I were foreign like Sean, I would leave the company.
ar: لَوْ كُنْتُ أَجْنَبِيًّا مِثْلَ شُون، لَتَرَكْتُ الشَّرِكَة.

en: If I had ten million dollars today, I would also leave.
ar: لَوْ كَانَ لَدَيَّ عَشَرَةُ مَلَايِينِ دُولَارٍ اليَوْمَ، لَغَادَرْتُ أَيْضًا.

en: The University of Michigan is a public university.
